battleTraits.name: The Quarry
battleTraits.effect: If no enemy units are the quarry, pick an enemy unit to be the quarry (you can pick an enemy unit in reserve).

battleTraits.name: Blood-Drenched
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that slew any enemy models using a Fight ability this turn to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).
battleTraits.timingText: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn

regimentAbilities.name: The Scent of Blood
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn.

regimentAbilities.name: Savagery Upon Savagery
regimentAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.
regimentAbilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons (add D3 instead if the target is a Hero).
regimentAbilities.timingText: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

enhancements.name: Evasive Hunter
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: Killing Pounce
enhancements.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for your general, you can roll an additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do they must finish that charge in combat with the quarry.
enhancements.timingText: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase

enhancements.name: Furious Bites
enhancements.effect: If your general is in combat with the quarry, inflict D3 mortal damage on the quarry.

abilities.name: Stalk the Prey
abilities.effect: This unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat unless it was in combat at the start of that move, and if there is an enemy quarry on the battlefield it must end that move closer to the quarry.

abilities.name: Unflagging Hunters
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Pack Hunters
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with both this unit and a friendly Flesh Hounds unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit's combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
